ranked.headline: Computational methods map spatial gene expression and pathway activity in tissue
ranked.summary: Spatial omics and AI-segmented histology are increasingly paired with computational frameworks that infer spatial gene and pathway organization.

ranked.headline: Refined statistical frameworks sharpen genetic association and heritability estimates
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale cohorts and multi-omics data demand association methods that model epistasis, multitrait structure and gene-level evidence.

ranked.headline: Pretrained protein language model embeddings reused as searchable, aligned representations
ranked.summary: Recent work applies protein language model embeddings to function prediction, interaction prediction, and retrieval across protein and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: ML and physics-based methods predict molecular recognition and expose docking limits
ranked.summary: Learned scoring models are being coupled to physics-based sampling while benchmarks increasingly document where all-atom and docking tools fail.

ranked.headline: Scalable tools for spatial omics, mass spectrometry, and circadian analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release scalable tools for spatial transcriptomics, HRMS peak picking, and interactive omics embedding exploration.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks map cortical, fly visual, and neural decoding data
ranked.summary: Three December 2025 preprints introduce explicit computational frameworks for retinotopic mapping, connectome-based prediction, and neural decoding.

ranked.headline: Dedicated pipelines for long-read, duplex and bacterial single-cell sequencing analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair long-read, duplex and single-cell assays with purpose-built workflows that address their specific processing demands.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic data resolve causal and context-specific gene regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Scalable single-cell eQTL mapping and Perturb-seq-informed causal graphs now allow context-specific regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: Protein and antibody language models steered toward defined design objectives
ranked.summary: Sparse autoencoders, self-distillation, and co-folding training data now probe and steer biological sequence generation.

ranked.headline: Compact k-mer indexing and hashing tools for sequence and ancient DNA analysis
ranked.summary: Recent tools compress and hash k-mer sets, sketch long reads, and authenticate ancient metagenomic alignments at the taxon level.

ranked.headline: Simulation-based ground truth benchmarks sequencing tools for variants and modifications
ranked.summary: Known-truth simulation enables controlled, reproducible evaluation of sequencing tools across coverage, mapping, hybridization, and modification detection.

ranked.headline: Single-cell method benchmarks expose trade-offs in feature selection and batch correction
ranked.summary: Method choices now shape single-cell and pseudobulk results, and recent benchmarks quantify their effects.

ranked.headline: Deep generative and contrastive models integrate heterogeneous omics and text data
ranked.summary: Recent work extends learned joint representations of omics data toward transfer across species, datasets, and modalities, with benchmarked evaluation.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised embeddings couple omics representations to phenotypes and trajectories
ranked.summary: Multi-omic, longitudinal, and single-cell data are pushing representation learning toward self-supervised objectives and domain constraints.

ranked.headline: Computational refinement of variant calls via annotation, curation, and filtering
ranked.summary: Population frequencies, phenotype data, and ClinVar update checks are now being combined into computational workflows for variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained and scattering-guided models resolve DEAD-box helicase ensembles
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained ensemble models are now being tied to scattering data and in vivo measurements in DEAD-box helicases and cohesin.

ranked.headline: Latent models relate imaging, genotype and phenotypes in neurodegeneration
ranked.summary: Latent models now decompose imaging, genetic and cognitive variation in neurodegeneration, with longitudinal and mediation structure made explicit.

ranked.headline: Explicit objectives now guide single-cell lineage inference and clustering resolution
ranked.summary: Recent scRNA-seq and lineage tracing methods state explicit optimization targets rather than implicit heuristics.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked Simulation Protocols for GPCR Activation and Drug Residence Time
ranked.summary: Method and protocol choices in free-energy and screening workflows are now being benchmarked and reported explicitly rather than assumed.

ranked.headline: Haplotype and crossover structure are being encoded for genetic association workflows
ranked.summary: Explicit haplotype and recombination modeling is entering association and genomic prediction tooling as published software and preprints appear.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked scoring of transcriptomic features across RNA-seq and spatial datasets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply explicit benchmarks to senescence markers, RNA editing indices, and spatial ligand-receptor fields.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings of drugs, miRNAs and proteins for association prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications fuse graph and sequence modalities via attention, transformers and contrastive learning for drug, miRNA and target prediction.

ranked.headline: Sequence data delimit bacterial taxa and track plasmid-mediated gene dissemination
ranked.summary: Large-scale genomic and metagenomic datasets now allow hierarchical, quantitative taxonomy and resistance-mutation detection directly from sequence reads.

ranked.headline: Molecular profiles mapped to cancer treatment failure, drug sensitivity and IDH1 status
ranked.summary: Multimodal agents, interpretable driver panels, and tree and kernel models now link genomic and clinical features to oncology outcomes.

ranked.headline: ML models predict T cell and cytokine-inducing peptide immunogenicity from sparse data
ranked.summary: Limited labeled peptide data and multidomain immunogenicity inputs are motivating generative augmentation and transfer strategies for peptide prediction.

ranked.headline: Checking learned and Bayesian samplers against physical observables and populations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test generative and Bayesian samplers against conformational populations, thermodynamic constraints, and physical observables.

ranked.headline: Neural and semi-supervised tools infer protein and lipid subcellular localization
ranked.summary: Organelle profiling and spatial proteomics data now support localization inference that extends from proteins to lipids.

ranked.headline: Stochastic models link reproductive timing, replication asymmetry, and repeat evolution
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply stochastic models to reproductive timing, proteostasis, and tandem repeat length distributions across genomes.

ranked.headline: Structure-based computation designs nucleases and antibodies with tailored properties
ranked.summary: Structure-conditioned generative methods now target nuclease and antibody scaffolds, with evidence from screening, cryo-EM, and de novo design workflows.

ranked.headline: Curated references and coverage models curb false taxa in microbiome profiling
ranked.summary: Recent items add curated fungal references, coverage-aware profilers, and expanded gene catalogs for complex community profiling.

ranked.headline: Structural energetics guide nucleic acid sequence design and RNA parameter estimation
ranked.summary: Recent work couples backbone geometry to ssDNA sequence design and differentiable RNA energy parameter estimation.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved and T2T assemblies reshape variant and transcriptomic analyses
ranked.summary: Gap-free and haplotype-resolved references now propagate into population genomics, deleterious variant scoring and single-nucleus cell-type calls.

ranked.headline: Chromatin contacts, X inactivation and chromosome evolution across genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read and single-cell methods now resolve chromosome-scale architecture, from repetitive-region contacts to active X calling.

ranked.headline: Workflows and databases for prophage detection, host prediction, and lysin discovery
ranked.summary: Large metagenomic resources, including EnVhogDB, now enable discovery-scale lysin mining and automated prophage-host profiling in single workflows.

ranked.headline: Force fields overbind cations to phosphates; residue networks trace distal thermal paths
ranked.summary: Classical all-atom force fields overbind monovalent cations to phosphate groups, and new corrections and GPU constant-pH tools target these energetics.

ranked.headline: Shared resources reshape weights and thresholds in molecular neural network designs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published hardware study extend perceptron-style molecular computation to resource-limited and physical implementations.

ranked.headline: Modeling Frameworks Reveal Persistence Rules in Antagonistic Microbial Communities
ranked.summary: Simulation studies now map how oscillatory extinction, biofilm signaling, and antagonism shape microbial coexistence and survival.

ranked.headline: AlphaFold3 benchmarks on disordered proteins and amyloid polymorphs show uneven accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test AlphaFold-family predictors on disordered proteins and amyloid polymorphs, where monomer and multimer behaviour diverge.

ranked.headline: Packaging omics result storage, annotation validation and gene-set redundancy tools
ranked.summary: Bioconductor and command-line tools now standardise derived omics outputs, genome annotations and enrichment results across interfaces.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods for batch correction, spatial denoising and phylogenetic inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study refine estimators for single-cell batch effects, spatial transcriptomics noise and phylogenetic tree inference.
